description:
Compare two newline-separated lists. Returns union, intersection, only-in-A, and only-in-B.

Returns: JSON { union, intersection, onlyInA, onlyInB } arrays.
Example input: {"a":"apple
banana
cherry","b":"banana
cherry
date"}

a.description: First list, one item per line.

b.description: Second list, one item per line.

trim.description: Trim each line before comparing (default true).

name: list_compare
title: List comparison
